screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_story.title: Story
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_story.locke: locked until an earlier saga is told
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_story.none: No saga begun. Pick a difficulty and press Begin on a saga that is ready. To speak with a master or the Keeper, pick "Talk about training" (a master) or "Talk about work" (the Keeper) in their menu.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_story.no_jo: None. Speak with a master or the Keeper for a job.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_saga_canno: That saga cannot be begun now.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_saga_aband: You set the saga '%1$s' down. It can be begun again.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_saga_no_sp: They only speak of the old story to those who fight with ki.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_saga_keepe: This one is for the Keeper on the Lookout.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_saga_hint: The place lies about %1$s blocks to the %2$s.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_saga_hint_: No sign of it yet. The Aether's monoliths rise in the wild, far from any town.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_saga_boss: %1$s steps out of the dust to meet you.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_saga_no_gi: No Giants walk this world, so that part of the road is passed.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_jobs_none: There is no work for you now. Finish your jobs or come back tomorrow.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_job_busy: You already hold %1$s jobs. Finish one first.
saga.jaymospowers.step.talk: Speak with a master or the Keeper (their menu: Talk about training, or Talk about work).
saga.jaymospowers.step.talk_keeper: Speak with the Keeper on the Lookout (his menu: Talk about work).
saga.jaymospowers.step.stats: Raise your stats to %1$s levels in all.
saga.jaymospowers.step.form: Open a form (Super is the first).
saga.jaymospowers.step.shrine: Find a shrine and stand at it.
saga.jaymospowers.step.tower: Find the white Tower and stand at its foot.
saga.jaymospowers.step.chamber: Step through the Lookout's door into the Time Chamber.
saga.jaymospowers.step.deliver: Hand %1$s %2$s to a master or the Keeper.
saga.jaymospowers.step.giant: Defeat one of the Aether's Giants.
saga.jaymospowers.job.spar: Win %1$s bouts against a Sparring Dummy.
saga.jaymospowers.ashes.title: A Spark in the Ashes
saga.jaymospowers.ashes.intro: The sky broke long ago, and its pieces are still settling into the world. The old fighters say only those who carry ki can feel where.
saga.jaymospowers.ashes.done: The Ash Rival yields, laughing in the dust. 'Then you are the one it chose,' he says, and the stone at the shrine goes warm in your hand.
saga.jaymospowers.ashes.step0: Find a master, or the Keeper high on the Lookout, and let them take your measure.
saga.jaymospowers.ashes.step1: The old fighter wants proof that you can bear more than you do now. Grow stronger.
saga.jaymospowers.ashes.step2: The first piece of the sky fell at a shrine. Go and stand where it fell.
saga.jaymospowers.ashes.step3: Someone else felt the call and came for the shrine's stone before you. He waits in the dust.
saga.jaymospowers.ashes.said0: 'The Aether did not die,' the old fighter says. 'It came apart, and every piece waits for someone strong enough to carry it. Grow, then walk to the shrines it left behind.'
saga.jaymospowers.sky.title: What the Sky Left Behind
saga.jaymospowers.sky.intro: The Keeper has watched the world from the Lookout since before the towns. The last pieces of the Aether are not stones but sleepers: monoliths, and the Giants that wake beside them.
saga.jaymospowers.sky.done: The Giant falls and its monolith goes dark for good. Far above, the Keeper lets out a breath held for a thousand years.
saga.jaymospowers.sky.step0: Climb to the Lookout and ask the Keeper what is left of the sky.
saga.jaymospowers.sky.step1: The Keeper says the pieces wake when the land is restless. Put down the creatures that trouble it.
saga.jaymospowers.sky.step2: A Giant will crush anyone who cannot bend ki into a second shape. Open a form.
saga.jaymospowers.sky.step3: Walk to the white Tower. The Keeper says it was built to see the monoliths from far off.
saga.jaymospowers.sky.step4: Find a monolith in the wild and bring down the Giant that wakes beside it. The first Giant to fall changes the whole world.
saga.jaymospowers.sky.said0: 'There were four highlands in the Aether,' the Keeper says. 'Green meadows, lodestone peaks, frozen ridges, and woods that glowed sick. Each left one sleeper. When the sleepers fall, the sky is finally still, and the world grows harder to meet.'
saga.jaymospowers.crown.title: The Hollow Crown
saga.jaymospowers.crown.intro: A fighter took a splinter of the Aether for a crown and was emptied by it. A master wants him found before the hollowing spreads.
saga.jaymospowers.crown.done: The Hollow King's crown cracks and the sky-glass inside goes still. Whatever was left of the fighter sighs, and is gone.
saga.jaymospowers.crown.step0: Ask a master, or the Keeper, about the fighter with the crown of glass.
saga.jaymospowers.crown.step1: The crown is made of sky-glass, and sky-glass sings to amethyst. Bring shards of it to a master for a ward.
saga.jaymospowers.crown.step2: A ward is only as strong as whoever wears it. Grow stronger.
saga.jaymospowers.crown.step3: The ward needs time to set. Step into the Time Chamber behind the Lookout's door, where hours pass like days.
saga.jaymospowers.crown.step4: With the ward set, go out and meet the Hollow King. He will find you.
saga.jaymospowers.crown.step5: Return to the master and tell what became of the crown.
saga.jaymospowers.crown.said0: 'He was a good fighter once,' the master says. 'The crown eats what is behind the eyes and leaves the strength. Bring me sky-glass, and I will make you something he cannot hollow.'
saga.jaymospowers.crown.said5: The master turns the splintered crown over in his hands. 'It will be kept where it cannot call,' he says. 'Take what it cost him to pay you.'
